free_tier.stated: No free GPU allowance: GPU Clusters price the NVIDIA HGX H100 at $1.99 preemptible, $3.99 on demand and $3.69 reserved for 3-30 days per GPU per hour; the current table shows the first three as sold out and quotes the 91+ day term by request.
